activities.name: Temple tour with the monkey forest
activities.match: Bali Temple Tour with Monkey Forest
activities.description: A full day among the temples, taking in Taman Ayun, the Alas Kedaton monkey forest and the cliff top temple at Uluwatu.

activities.name: Water sports at Tanjung Benoa
activities.description: A half day combo at Tanjung Benoa with banana boat, jet ski and parasailing, all with life jackets and an instructor in the water.

activities.name: Sunset dinner cruise
activities.description: A half day cruise out of Benoa harbour with dinner on board and live music, timed for sunset over the Bukit peninsula.

program.name: Kuta
program.description: Three nights beachfront at Tuban, with a temple day that ends at Uluwatu, water sports at Tanjung Benoa and a sunset cruise with dinner.

activities.name: Kintamani with the jungle swing
activities.description: Coffee plantation tasting on the climb to Kintamani, the crater lake view, Tegenungan waterfall, the Tegalalang terraces and the jungle swing.

activities.name: Balinese massage in Ubud
activities.description: A traditional Balinese massage with warm oil and long pressure strokes, booked privately at a spa in Ubud on your free day.

program.name: Ubud
program.description: Two nights in a rice field resort to finish, reached by way of Kintamani, with a spa afternoon and a free day for the town.

1: Arrival at Ngurah Rai Airport and private transfer to your hotel
Check in at your beachfront resort at Tuban
Rest of the day free by the pool or on the sand
Optional: Kuta Square, the art market or a sunset walk
2: Breakfast, then a full day among the temples
Taman Ayun and the Alas Kedaton monkey forest
Uluwatu temple on the cliffs in the late afternoon
Optional: the Kecak fire dance at the temple
3: Breakfast, then a morning at Tanjung Benoa beach
Banana boat, jet ski and parasailing with an instructor
Sunset cruise out of Benoa harbour in the evening
Dinner and live music on board as the light goes
4: Breakfast and check out, then north through coffee country
The crater lake view at Kintamani
Tegenungan waterfall, the rice terraces and the jungle swing
Check in at your rice field resort near Ubud
5: Breakfast and a free morning at the resort
A traditional Balinese massage at an Ubud spa
Optional: the Monkey Forest or the Saraswati water temple
Optional: the art market and the palace in the town centre
6: Breakfast at the resort and check out
Private transfer to Ngurah Rai Airport for your flight home

expert.name: Putu
expert.quote: Beach first, rice fields second, and a four star hotel at both ends. It is the easiest Bali week to recommend.
expert.tip: Ask for a pool view room at Rama Beach and a garden villa at Granary. On the cruise day have a light lunch, dinner on board is generous and starts around seven.

summary: Six days with four star hotels at both ends: three nights beachfront at Tuban with a temple day at Uluwatu, water sports and a sunset dinner cruise, then two nights in the Ubud rice fields by way of Kintamani, with a spa afternoon.
included: Included: 5 nights with daily breakfast; private airport and inter city transfers; temple tour with the monkey forest and Uluwatu; water sports at Tanjung Benoa; sunset dinner cruise; Kintamani and jungle swing tour; a Balinese massage in Ubud.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Indonesia visa fees; lunches and other dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
